summary: Light winds today will become northeasterly on Tuesday, strengthening enough on Tuesday night to bring a high risk of rip currents to Franklin County beaches on Wednesday. A cold front on Wednesday night will shift winds around westerly or northwesterly on Thursday and Friday. These winds will push surf more directly at Panhandle beaches and increase the risk of rip currents.

Moderate rip current risk*. Partly sunny. Highs in the lower 60s. Northwest winds around 15 mph.
